```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'MYR'
),
captures as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.order_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join countries co on co.country_code = s.country_code
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and co.name = 'Malaysia'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
),
captured as (
    select sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from captures c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
),
refunded as (
    select sum(rf.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from refunds rf
    join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join countries co on co.country_code = s.country_code
    join fx on fx.currency = rf.currency and fx.rate_date = rf.business_date
    where rf.status = 'processed'
      and not o.is_test
      and co.name = 'Malaysia'
      and rf.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
)
select null as key,
       cast(round(coalesce(captured.amount, 0) - coalesce(refunded.amount, 0)) as bigint) as value
from captured, refunded
order by value
```
